title: Basketball Front Office LLM Powered Simulation
author: blueskydreams21
selftext:
One of my favorite features in the game I've been building since April--tampering! There are a few fun things at play here:

\- When a player on a different team's contract is expiring, you can send a clandestine message to him from a burner phone. When you do that, the player cannot re-sign with his current team, and you have an increased chance of signing him in the summer. However, when you tamper, there is a chance the commissioner will catch you in the act and take a couple of draft picks. You can tamper with up to three players. Each player you tamper with increases your chances of getting caught.

\- You'll notice that Kendall has a persistent memory of our past interactions. I've designed the game so that all NPCs have persistent memories. It makes the game feel a lot more real.

\- All of the dialogue is generated by an LLM (which LLM is used depends on the situation). So there are no preprogrammed responses.

https://i.redd.it/gdn9nc1ew7yh1.png
